traps.note: The literal mapped-loopback example names the embedded-IPv4 surface; the 'any check the library offers' scope also reaches isLoopback/isLinkLocal/isMulticast/isUnspecified and the NAT64 variants.

traps.quote: Any check the library offers that classifies an address as internal or public
traps.note: No fe80, link-local, /10 or /64 identifier; only the clause widening the duty from one check to every internal/public classifier points at isLinkLocal.

traps.quote: Any check the library offers that classifies an address as internal or public
traps.note: Nothing says CIDR, prefix, suffix or host-with-a-prefix; coverage is the same widened all-checks clause plus 'the address the value actually reaches', not the containment short-circuit.
The Address6 identifier that must answer for the local-use block is named, though 64:ff9b:1::/48 and the operator-chosen prefix length are not.
